subject: importinto: use memory-per-core for import and backfill budgeting (#66564)
summary: Reviewed b194391126 relative to parent 987e37ff: adds `StepResource.MemoryPerCore()` and switches import-into KV-writer buffering and DDL merge-sort upload part sizing to use per-core memory (avoids mismatched `plan.ThreadCnt` vs DXF runtime slots, and avoids div-by-zero when CPU<=0). Import-into additionally caps parquet encode/sort concurrency via a one-time parquet reader peak-memory estimate. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine issues found; no follow-up fixes for these paths observed up to `upstream/master`.
